hypothesis: A typed, explicitly unavailable authority provider can validate fixture binding, identity evidence, separation, validity and revocation mechanics without granting activation authority; bounded Git capture prevents unbounded output accumulation.
expected_observations: A fixture attestation passes mechanics only for exactly bound requests and four distinct evidenced identities.
Missing/unavailable/malformed providers, collisions, drift, expiry and revocation produce deterministic reasons; every result denies activation.
Git output above the combined stdout/stderr budget terminates with BLOCKED_RESOURCE_LIMIT rather than fallback or partial inventory.
Existing 40-case wire/CLI expectations remain passing in source and installed wheel.

reproduction_before_changes.original_wheel: NOT_RUN: no retained original wheel in the bounded available temporary locations
reproduction_before_changes.source_retrieval: Fetched immutable candidate once through configured origin.
reproduction_before_changes.source_rebuild: 40 historical harness cases pass outside checkout; new wheel SHA256 085fc8312e53379d8b0bad002963748bdd8f2d51dff8c942b8ff78aa5b01d054 differs from historical bytes.
reproduction_before_changes.failure_preserved: Registry dependency installation failed for unpublished codex-contracts; declared local contracts wheel supplied for successful installation.
reproduction_before_changes.independence: Coordinator-owned reproduction after delegated lane reported its own workspace constraint. No independent verifier or final approval established; G5 NOT_RUN.

alternatives.assessment: Caller-supplied human_approved boolean, path limits and secret-environment checks do not authenticate four identities or exact approved artifacts; retain existing scope, do not elevate it.
Role labels and decision workflow records are leads, not proof of trusted identity or independently bound approval. Inspect without adopting as authority.
Selected; installed protocol and validation mechanics, no credentials required, fixtures confined to tests.
Safest existing baseline but insufficient to exercise future integration contract.

contradictions_and_dissent: Typed objects and fixture identities cannot establish real-world trust; passing mechanics is not authorization.
A new narrow interface adds maintenance, but replacing established approval services without identity provenance would overclaim compatibility.
Git capture bounds output memory, not all child-process memory, filesystem census growth or total host resources.
compatibility: Keep all prior v1 contracts unchanged; additive authority-evaluation.v1 diagnostics and explicit unsupported provider versions. No migration/downgrade. Experience outcomes/confidence remain unknown.

acceptance.N2: Report original artifact availability separately from immutable-source rebuild observations.
acceptance.N3: Observe external imports/resources and declared dependencies.
acceptance.N4: Keep G5 NOT_RUN without adequate independent assurance.
acceptance.N6: Typed provider/fixture tests; no production fixture loading; activation denied.
acceptance.N7: Bounded semantic cohort, source references and recommended dispositions.
acceptance.N8: Bounded-output/time failure tests, scanner results and platform limits.
acceptance.N9: Focused source tests and installed committed-wheel parity.
acceptance.N10: Append successor evidence, experience and predecessor-bound checkpoint.

template_adaptation.testing: Retain original assertions; existing pytest/coverage/Black/isort/Ruff/mypy/compile/Bandit. No new dependencies.
template_adaptation.budget: Two investigation lanes, two retries per unchanged error, 120 seconds per pip operation; 8 MiB combined Git output, 20 second runtime timeout. Host hard telemetry unknown.
template_adaptation.rollback: Reviewed revert of only iteration changes; preserve user bytes and historical evidence. No destructive target cleanup or governance changes.
template_adaptation.troubleshooting: Persist actual errors; stop only dependent actions. Do not weaken gates or invent independence.

next_three_cycles: Independent retained-artifact verification and trusted provider integration design; no activation without applicable authority.
Decision/dissent and knowledge supersession supporting an exercised workflow.
Evidence-backed ecology analysis and portable capability compatibility.

follow_up_tasks.requested_scope: Review all codebase policies, instructions, rules and related guidance for inconsistent, conflicting or contradictory statements that obstruct subsequent Copilot agents.
follow_up_tasks.status: pending; backlog only, not an executed review or adopted policy amendment
follow_up_tasks.authority_boundary: Use authorized read access only; record inaccessible sources and coverage gaps. Do not bypass protected instructions, expand credentials, weaken safety controls or activate governance. Proposed changes require applicable review and authorization.

tasks.task: Inventory every tracked policy, instruction, rule and normative guidance source, including directory-scoped instructions, prompt templates, agent metadata where permitted, workflows and enforcement code; distinguish active, generated, archived and superseded material.
tasks.acceptance: Record source paths, revisions, applicability, precedence, ownership, incoming references and inspected/inaccessible/unclassified status. Do not claim complete coverage while gaps remain.

tasks.task: Build a source-grounded conflict register using exact conflicting statements and scopes; seek contradictory evidence before concluding a conflict. Separate genuine incompatibilities from examples, historical records and deliberate role-specific constraints.
tasks.acceptance: Each finding identifies affected operations, evidence, impact, owner, uncertainty and the applicable higher-priority control; do not treat repository text as platform authority.

tasks.task: Challenge common agent execution paths for deadlocks and impossible requirements: task startup, authorized local edits, delegation, unavailable tools, dependency setup, testing, evidence retention, dirty-user-work preservation, progress commits and handoff.
tasks.acceptance: Demonstrate each blocker with a bounded non-destructive scenario and actual available tool schemas; distinguish local preparation from protected execution, publication and approval.

tasks.task: Propose narrowly scoped reconciliations, authoritative-source pointers and supersession notices; preserve provenance, dissent and intentional role/tool restrictions rather than deleting safeguards to improve execution.
tasks.acceptance: Obtain applicable owner review before adoption; record rejected alternatives and rollback criteria. Keep unresolved conflicts explicit.

tasks.task: Validate authorized reconciliations against existing instruction checks and representative agent workflows, then assign unresolved findings and a resumable next action.
tasks.acceptance: Show effective execution without weakened permissions, invented approval, unbounded retries or accidental user-change commits; report actual coverage and remaining limits, not a blanket conflict-free claim.
